1 km playable square · grid 100 m · north up · P1 / P2 spawns · click to teleport (development)

Frest Sniper Royale

2 km of low-poly spruce and beech forest, granite tors, a mountain stream and a lake under the Alps. Only the centre 1 km square is playable.

Pickups

Magic Mushrooms+2% stamina per cluster
Raw meatgives limited health, cooked meat gives full health
Wood, lead ore, Tech Chips, gunpowder tinsfor crafting (coming later)

Stamina powers a double-speed boost: double-tap W and keep holding it. The longer you hold, the more it drains. Health starts at 100% and cooked food will raise it up to 200%.

Sound schedule (game clock)

Day sounds are the forest birds and wind; night sounds are the owls. Each fades in after its start time and fades out after its stop time, over the fade length in game minutes. Time flow above sets how quickly game minutes pass.

100% is the recording at its original level. Press M in game to mute everything.

1v1 match
Host a match and send the code to your opponent. They paste it and press Join match, then send you their reply code to paste back and Connect. One life per round, first to 3 rounds; 5 rounds loaded plus 15 spare.
